title: Changing Careers at Thirty-Five
paragraphs: After twelve years working in banking, Nabil decided to leave his stable job and retrain as a teacher, a decision that surprised most of his colleagues and worried his wife at first.
The first year of teacher training was financially tight, since his income dropped significantly, and he had to carefully budget expenses that his previous salary had made easy to overlook.

Despite the challenges, Nabil found himself genuinely excited about work for the first time in years, something he had almost forgotten was possible after so long feeling only mildly satisfied with banking.
Two years later, watching his students improve under his guidance, Nabil told a former colleague that the financial sacrifice had been entirely worth the sense of purpose he had gained.
